statement: Amend D-331 and D-335 (D-351) so significant operational weaknesses (VAL/NC not-met, breached SLO, unmet or unreviewed MEAS-cheaper-path, and ASSESS of an open system) prevent level F and closed: true in scripts/model measure while keeping catalog integrity reported separately, scripts/model check structural-only, and the 100 % acceptance target of D-337 intact; retire Origin-era slo.gate_tier1_p95_s instead of loosening it, keeping REQ-gate-60s (60 s) as canonical gate ceiling and budgets.tighten_only untouched.
note: Decided by D-351 (Torre por delegação do Daniel 22/11/2026; audit findings C1 and M3).
